stories.title: "Ça n'a pas duré longtemps, mais c'était extraordinaire" : avec les fans de Céline Dion, prêts à attendre des heures pour quelques minutes de leur idole

en.title: "It didn't last long, but it was extraordinary": with Céline Dion fans, ready to wait hours for a few minutes with their idol
en.summary: Fans of Québécois star Céline Dion have gathered daily outside her Paris hotel ahead of her highly anticipated sold-out concert series beginning Saturday. The singer greets waiting fans to acknowledge their patience.

stories.title: Une quarantaine de blessés, la piste d'un acte malveillant, le trafic perturbé... Ce que l'on sait après le déraillement d'un TER reliant Rouen à Caen

en.title: Around forty injured, suspicion of malicious act, traffic disrupted... What we know after a TER train derailment between Rouen and Caen
en.summary: A TER train carrying 186 passengers traveling from Rouen to Caen derailed with approximately forty injuries reported. A rail was found on the tracks used by the train, with investigation ongoing into possible foul play.

stories.title: Morceau de rail sur la voie, 44 blessés, une femme en «urgence absolue» : ce que l’on sait du déraillement d’un TER en Seine-Maritime

en.title: Rail piece on tracks, 44 injured, one woman in "absolute emergency": what we know about the TER derailment in Seine-Maritime
en.summary: A TER train with 186 passengers traveling from Rouen to Caen derailed in Seine-Maritime with 44 injured and one woman in critical condition. Police and SNCF are investigating the accident's causes.

stories.title: «Morceau de rail sur les voies» : la piste d’un acte malveillant est privilégiée après le déraillement d’un TER en Seine-Maritime

en.title: "Rail piece on tracks": the theory of a malicious act is favored after a TER derailment in Seine-Maritime
en.summary: After a TER train carrying 186 passengers from Rouen to Caen derailed, authorities are investigating a suspected malicious act involving a rail piece found on the tracks. Rouen's judicial police has been assigned the investigation.

stories.title: Le grand soir pour Céline Dion, après 6 ans d'absence à Paris

en.title: Céline Dion's big night, after 6 years away from Paris
en.summary: Céline Dion begins a series of concerts near Paris on Saturday evening after more than six years away, marking her return as a demonstration of resilience to fans worldwide.

stories.title: Céline Dion lance samedi soir une série de 16 concerts, pour son grand retour sur scène à Paris

en.title: Céline Dion launches a series of 16 concerts Saturday evening for her major comeback on stage in Paris
en.summary: The Québécois singer, absent from the stage for six years due to health reasons, will perform at Plenitude Arena through October 14, with ten additional dates scheduled for May.

stories.title: "Mettez-vous de bonnes chaussures !" : Céline Dion fait son retour à Paris

en.title: "Wear good shoes!": Céline Dion makes her return to Paris
en.summary: Céline Dion begins a series of sixteen concerts in France on Saturday evening before approximately 30,000 fans who traveled from around the world to witness her stage return following years of absence due to illness.

stories.title: Céline Dion en résidence à Paris : une tendance loin d'être nouvelle qui revient sur le devant de la scène

en.title: Céline Dion in residency in Paris: a trend far from new that returns to the spotlight
en.summary: The Québécois star begins a series of 16 concerts in Paris as part of a growing trend where artists replace traditional tours with fixed residencies in an evolving live entertainment industry.

stories.title: Céline Dion à Paris : la star donne le premier de ses concerts événement ce soir, suivez cette journée avec nous

en.title: Céline Dion in Paris: the star gives the first of her event concerts tonight, follow this day with us
en.summary: After two weeks of rehearsals, the Quebec star is preparing to return to the stage after a six-year absence, following a notable appearance at the Olympic Games opening ceremony.

stories.title: « C’est le meilleur cadeau de toute ma vie » : Paris en effervescence pour le début des concerts de Céline Dion

en.title: "It's the best gift of my entire life": Paris in excitement for the beginning of Céline Dion's concerts
en.summary: The star launches her first series of 16 concerts at the Plenitude Arena on Saturday at 8 p.m., transforming Paris into DionCity and expected to generate over one billion euros in revenue.

stories.title: "Mettez-vous de bonnes chaussures !" : Céline Dion fait son retour sur scène à Paris

en.title: "Wear good shoes!": Céline Dion makes her stage return in Paris
en.summary: Céline Dion begins a series of sixteen concerts in France on Saturday evening before approximately 30,000 people, marking her return to performing after several years away due to illness.

stories.title: «Ça permet de profiter du répertoire, mais gratuitement» : avant le concert de Céline Dion, les fans s’échauffent au karaoké géant de la Ville de Paris

en.title: "It allows us to enjoy the repertoire, but for free": before Céline Dion's concert, fans warm up at the City of Paris's giant karaoke
en.summary: Approximately 10,000 people attended a free karaoke event at Stalingrad on September 11 to sing Céline Dion's greatest hits, giving those without concert tickets access to the celebration.

stories.title: La Garonne en alerte sécheresse "renforcée" avec de nouvelles restrictions d'usage de l'eau

en.title: The Garonne on "reinforced" drought alert with new water usage restrictions
en.summary: The Garonne River has reached a reinforced alert level due to low rainfall and high temperatures, prompting new water usage restrictions announced by the Haute-Garonne prefecture.

stories.title: En Normandie, un TER déraille, faisant 44 blessés

en.title: In Normandy, a regional train derails, injuring 44 people
en.summary: A regional train derailed in Normandy, resulting in 44 people being injured in the incident.

stories.title: Franchises médicales: le plafond annuel passera de 100 à 140 euros en octobre

en.title: Medical deductibles: annual ceiling will increase from 100 to 140 euros in October
en.summary: The annual cap on medical deductibles that patients must pay out-of-pocket will rise from 100 to 140 euros starting October 1st, according to an official decree.

stories.title: Aux croisements d’un Segway et d’un fauteuil roulant high tech, Venturi Space dévoile son véhicule lunaire Alta Luna

en.title: At the crossroads of a Segway and a high-tech wheelchair, Venturi Space unveils its Alta Luna lunar vehicle
en.summary: A European electric mobility company presented two prototype vehicles in Paris, including one that revives a concept from nearly sixty years ago for use in extreme environments.

stories.title: Fibre Excellence : attaqué par Realtec, l’État obtient la reprise du site de Tarascon

en.title: Fibre Excellence: attacked by Realtec, the State obtains the takeover of the Tarascon site
en.summary: The State won a legal dispute with Realtec over requisition of the Tarascon industrial site. The company responsible for site security had challenged a prefectural order, with disagreement centered on fire alert systems and wastewater treatment facility operations.
